armySpecialRules.name: AMBUSH FROM THE WORLDROOTS
armySpecialRules.description: A Wood Elf army can always place an additional forest no more than 12" in diameter on the battlefield. This is done during deployment, before any units are deployed, and must be placed wholly in your half of the battlefield. Declare which type of forest it is when you place it. If you cannot fit the forest on your half of the table, move other terrain features by the shortest distance necessary so that the forest can be placed. If you still cannot place the forest, or if the scenario means that the Wood Elf army does not have a table half in which to deploy, this additional forest is not used in this battle.

armySpecialRules.name: ASRAI ARCHERY
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this rule do not suffer the normal -1 To Hit penalty for moving and shooting.

armySpecialRules.name: BLESSINGS OF THE ANCIENTS
armySpecialRules.description: A Wizard that has this rule and is within 6" of a forest gains a +1 casting and dispel bonus.

armySpecialRules.name: ELVEN SHORTBOW
armySpecialRules.description:
Elven shortbows have the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
16/24" | 3 | Armour Piercing (1), March & Shoot, Multiple Shots (2)*, Volley Fire
*Only applies in turns the model has not marched. Cannot be used as a charge reaction

armySpecialRules.name: ELVEN LONGBOW
armySpecialRules.description:
Elven longbows have the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
24/36" | 3 | Armour Piercing (1), Multiple Shots (2)*, Volley Fire
*Only applies in turns the model has not moved. Cannot be used as a charge reaction.

armySpecialRules.name: ELVEN GRACE
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this rule have the Dodge (6+) special rule in close combat. However, this cannot be used against enemies that attack before the model with Elven Grace.

armySpecialRules.name: ENCHANTED ARROWS
armySpecialRules.description:
Some models in the Wood Elf army have the option to purchase enchanted arrows. If a model has enchanted arrows, they must use them when shooting with Elven shortbows or longbows. Note that a model can only have one kind of Enchanted Arrows.
• Arcane Bodkins: Shooting attacks made with Arcane Bodkins have the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.
• Hagbane Tips: Shooting attacks made with Hagbane Tips have the Poisoned Attacks special rule.
• Moonfire Shot: Shooting attacks made with Moonfire Shot have the Flaming Attacks and Magical Attacks special rules.
• Starfire Shafts: Shooting attacks made with Starfire Shafts have the Magical Attacks special rule and force enemies to re-roll successful Panic tests caused by Heavy Casualties.
• Swiftshiver Shards: Shooting attacks made with Swiftshiver Shards allow the model to fire Multiple Shots even when moving (in case of longbows) or marching (in case of shortbows) that turn.
• Trueflight Arrows: Shooting attacks made with Trueflight Arrows ignore all shooting modifiers that are not caused by magic items or spells.

armySpecialRules.name: FOREST SPIRIT
armySpecialRules.description: A model with this rule has the Fear, Forest Strider, Immunity (Psychology), Magical Attacks and Magical Ward (5+) special rules. However, units of Forest Spirits may only be joined by characters that are also Forest Spirits and vice versa.

armySpecialRules.name: FOREST STALKER
armySpecialRules.description: While inside a wood, models with this special rule are at an additional -1 to be Hit with missile attacks. In addition, when using the Scouts special rule they may deploy within 12" of an enemy unit if they do so within a wood.

armySpecialRules.name: LETHAL SHOT
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this rule have the Killing Blow special rule with missile attacks from their Elven longbows or shortbows.

armySpecialRules.name: MARTIAL MEMORIES
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this rule may re-roll 1's when rolling To Hit and To Wound in close combat.

armySpecialRules.name: SAEARATH
armySpecialRules.description: Spear. Unless used with a shield in combat or when using the Mighty Blow (1) special rule from the weapon, a model armed with a saerath gains +1 Attack.

armySpecialRules.name: SHADOW DANCES OF LOEC
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this rule may choose one of the following Shadow Dances at the start of each round of close combat. This is done before Impact Hits are resolved. All models in the same unit must choose the same Shadow Dance. The effect of each Shadow Dance lasts until the end of that turn or until a new Shadow Dance is chosen. Models cannot choose the same Shadow Dance in two consecutive rounds of combat.
• Whirling Death: The model gains the Armour Piercing (1) and Killing Blow special rules.
• Storm of Blades: The model gains +1 Attack.
• The Shadows Coil: All close combat attacks against the model suffer -1 To Hit.
• Woven Mist: The model gains the Always Strikes First special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: TREE ASPECTS
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this rule may choose one of the following Tree Aspects at the start of each round of close combat. This is done before Impact Hits are resolved. All models in the same unit must choose the same Tree Aspect. The effect of each Tree Aspect lasts until the end of that turn or until a new Tree Aspect is chosen. Models cannot choose the same Tree Aspect in two consecutive rounds of combat.
• Birch Aspect: The model gains +1 Attack.
• Oak Aspect: The model gains +1 Toughness.
• Willow Aspect: All close combat attacks against the model suffer -1 To Hit.

armySpecialRules.name: TREE WHACK
armySpecialRules.description: A model with this rule can choose to make a single Tree Whack in place of making their normal close combat attacks. To resolve a Tree Whack, nominate an enemy model in base contact. That model must pass an Initiative test or suffer D6 Wounds which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: THE SPIRIT SWORD
magicItems.description: Armour saves cannot be taken against Wounds caused by the Spirit Sword. Furthermore, immediately when an enemy single model unit or Character suffers one or more unsaved Wounds from the Spirit Sword, both they and the wielder must roll 2D6 and add their respective Leadership values. If the wounded model’s total is higher, or the totals are the same, nothing else happens. If the wounded model’s total is lower, it immediately suffers a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves for each point by which its total was exceeded.

magicItems.name: DAITH'S REAPER
magicItems.description: All failed To Hit and To Wound rolls made with Daith's Reaper must be re-rolled, as must all successful armour saves taken against Wounds caused by this weapon.

magicItems.name: DAWNSPEAR
magicItems.description: If the wielder of the Dawnspear causes an unsaved wound on an enemy, then all enemy models in that unit that have not yet attacked suffer -1 To Hit in this round of close combat.

magicItems.name: CALLACH'S CLAW
magicItems.description: Any unit suffering one or more unsaved wounds from the Callach's Claw suffers a -2 penalty to their Leadership for the remainder of the Combat phase.

magicItems.name: THE HUNTER'S TALON
magicItems.description: The Hunter's Talon gives the wielder the Sniper special rule.

magicItems.name: SPEAR OF DAITH
magicItems.description: The Spear of Daith gives the wielder the Parry (5+) special rule.

magicItems.name: THE BOW OF LOREN
magicItems.description: All shots from the Bow of Loren are resolved at Strength 4 with Multiple Shots (A) special rule. Multiple Shots (A) means the bow fires a number of shots equal to the wielder’s Attacks characteristic. It cannot fire enchanted arrows.

magicItems.name: BLADES OF LOEC
magicItems.description: The Blades of Loec allow the wielder to re-roll failed rolls To Wound.

magicItems.name: GREENWOOD GLADIUS
magicItems.description: The wielder of this item gains +D3 Attacks, rolled at the start of each round of close combat.

magicItems.name: HUNT MASTER'S PRIDE
magicItems.description: All attacks with this weapon have the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: SPEAR OF TWILIGHT
magicItems.description: The Spear of Twilight gives the wielder the Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: SWORD OF A THOUSAND WINTERS
magicItems.description: The Sword of a Thousand Winters gives the bearer the Ice Attacks special rule. In addition, Characters and Monsters must take a Toughness test for each unsaved wound suffered by the Sword of a Thousand Winters. For every test failed, they suffer -1 Strength, Initiative and Attacks for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: VAUL'S WRATH
magicItems.description:
This weapon has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
24/36" | 4 | Armour Piercing (1), Multiple Shots (2), Multiple Wounds (2), Volley Fire

magicItems.name: SPEAR OF THE HUNT
magicItems.description: This item gives the wielder the Armour Piercing (1) special rule. In addition, they and any unit they are with may re-roll 1's for their charge distance.

magicItems.name: SPLINTERBIRCH BLADE
magicItems.description: Whenever an enemy model makes a successful save against Wounds caused by this blade, they suffer an additional D6 Strength 1 Hits.

magicItems.name: STARCASTER LONGBOW
magicItems.description: All shots from this bow have the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule. On a To Wound roll of a natural 6, that shot has the Multiple Wounds (D6) special rule instead.

magicItems.name: ASYENDI'S BANE
magicItems.description: This weapon allows the wielder to re- roll all failed rolls To Hit. However, if the shot still misses after this re-roll, then they suffer a Strength 3 hit.

magicItems.name: RAGETH'S WILDFIRE BLADES
magicItems.description: Rageth's Wildfire Blades give the wielder the Flaming Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF THE FEY
magicItems.description: The Armour of the Fey gives the bearer the Magical Ward (4+) special rule against Magical Attacks.

magicItems.name: THE OAKEN ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The Oaken Armour gives the wearer the Regeneration (4+) special rule.

magicItems.name: CLOAK OF TUMBLING LEAVES
magicItems.description: The bearer's gains the Fly (10) special rule.

magicItems.name: BRIARSHEATH
magicItems.description: The Briarsheath causes any missile attacks targeted at the wearer to suffer -1 To Hit, or -2 To Hit if the wearer is in a forest.

magicItems.name: THE HELM OF THE HUNT
magicItems.description: This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. In addition, they may re-roll To Hit in turns that they successfully charge into combat.

magicItems.name: RAILARIAN'S MANTLE
magicItems.description: Railarian's Mantle gives the wearer a Magical Ward (5+) if they are within 6" of a forest.

magicItems.name: AMBER ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The bearer's armour save can never be reduced below a 6+.

magicItems.name: RHYMER'S HARP
magicItems.description: The Rhymer's Harp gives the bearer and any unit they join the Magical Ward (5+) and Strider special rules.

magicItems.name: GLAMOURWEAVE BROOCH
magicItems.description: The Glamourweave Brooch gives the bearer the Magical Ward (4+) special rule against missile attacks. In addition, any model attempting to strike the bearer in close combat must first pass a Leadership test or require 6's To Hit the bearer during that Combat phase.

magicItems.name: AMARANTHINE BROOCH
magicItems.description: The Amaranthine Brooch gives the wearer the Magical Ward (4+) special rule against non-Magical Attacks.

magicItems.name: STONE OF THE CRYSTAL MERE
magicItems.description: The Stone of the Crystal Mere gives the bearer the Magical Ward (3+) special rule. However, if this Ward Save is ever failed, the Magical Ward is lost for the rest of the game.

magicItems.name: AMBER PENDANT
magicItems.description: The Amber Pendant causes all enemy units in base contact with the wearer to be subject to the Always Strikes Last special rule.

magicItems.name: FIMBULWINTER SHARD
magicItems.description: The Fimbulwinter Shard causes enemies attacking the bearer in close combat to suffer -1 To Hit. However, all models with the Forest Spirit special rule (including the bearer) suffer from Stupidity while the bearer is within 6".

magicItems.name: TALISMAN OF QWARR
magicItems.description: Models targeting the bearer with missile attacks must re-roll successful rolls To Hit.

magicItems.name: STONE OF REBIRTH
magicItems.description: If the bearer of the Stone of Rebirth is killed, roll a D6. On a 2+, the model is brought back to life with one Wound remaining. This has no effect if the wearer was killed as a result of being pursued down.

magicItems.name: MERCIW'S LOCUS
magicItems.description: Merciw's Locus causes the bearer and any model attacking them to lose all Strength bonuses from any weapon they might carry.

magicItems.name: DEEPMIRE CLOAK
magicItems.description: If the wearer is in cover and is at their starting number of Wounds, enemy missile attacks targeting them suffer -1 To Hit. If the wearer is in cover and has suffered one or more Wounds during the game, they cannot be targeted by missile attacks at all.

magicItems.name: ORB OF MIDSUMMER
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may re-roll failed casting attempts, unless a Miscast has been rolled.

magicItems.name: RANU'S HEARTSTIONE
magicItems.description: Once per Magic phase, the bearer of this item may re-roll one of the dice when casting or dispelling a spell. This can be used to prevent a miscast or to cause Ultimate Power.

magicItems.name: VESPERAL GEM
magicItems.description: This item can be used at the start of your Magic phase. Once used, the Wizard can automatically cast any one of their spells from the Lore of Athel Loren without using any power dice this turn. This spell cannot be dispelled. After resolving the effects of the spell, roll a D6. On a 1, the bearer suffers 1 Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: OAKEN STAVE
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may roll an extra D6 when dispelling and discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: SILVERWOOD CIRCLET
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item adds +12" to the range of all their spells (excluding auras).

magicItems.name: VIRIDESCENT SHAWL
magicItems.description: This item gives the bearer a +1 casting bonus. In addition, all enemy missile attacks targeting the bearer suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: DIVINATION ORB
magicItems.description: If an opponent uses more than three power dice (from any source) when casting any spell, the bearer of the Divination Orb may add an extra free Dispel dice into the attempt to dispel that spell.

magicItems.name: DEEPWOOD SPHERE
magicItems.description: Any enemy unit that enters a forest within 18" of the bearer of the Deepwood Sphere suffers D6 Strength 4 Hits as soon as they have finished their move. They continue to suffer D6 Strength 4 Hits at the start of any of their Movement phases for as long as they remain in the forest and the bearer of the item remains within range.

magicItems.name: ELF CHARM
magicItems.description: When casting spells from the Lore of Life, the wizard may add a +D3 casting bonus once per Magic phase.

magicItems.name: CALAINGOR'S STAVE
magicItems.description: When casting the Tree Singing spell from the Lore of Athel Loren, the bearer may re-roll the distance the forest moves.

magicItems.name: HEARTWOOD PENDANT
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item may choose their spells from the Lore of Athel Loren in addition to one other spell lore.

magicItems.name: WARSONG STAVE
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item knows the Tree Singing spell from the Lore of Athel Loren in addition to their other spells.

magicItems.name: WENDING WAND
magicItems.description: Any friendly unit that pursued off the table can enter the table from any point of any table edge of their choice in their next turn, as long as it is within 24" of the bearer of this item.

magicItems.name: SIGIL OF THE MAGE QUEEN
magicItems.description: This item may be used after making a casting roll. When used, it adds a +3 casting bonus.

magicItems.name: CROWN OF FELL BOWERS
magicItems.description: The wearer and any unit they are with gain +1 To Wound in close combat.

magicItems.name: WARDROTH HORN
magicItems.description: This item may be used at the start of any close combat phase. Once used, all friendly units (excluding mounts) within 12" gain +1 Attack for the duration of this turn.

magicItems.name: MOONSTONE OF THE HIDDEN WAYS
magicItems.description: If the bearer’s unit is wholly within a forest at the end of your Movement phase, and is not in close combat, it can forestwalk. If it does so, remove it from the battlefield and immediately replace it, wholly within any forest on the battlefield, just like a summoning spell. A unit that forestwalks counts as having marched in the Movement phase.

magicItems.name: HAIL OF DOOM ARROW
magicItems.description:
Model with Elven longbow only. The Hail of Doom arrow can be used instead of making a Shooting attack with the bearer’s Elven longbow, though it cannot be used with the Sniper rule. Declare that the Hail of Doom Arrow is being used before any dice are rolled.
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
24/36" | 4 | Multiple Shots (3D6)

magicItems.name: FORGET-ME-KNOT
magicItems.description: This item can be used against one enemy model in base contact at the start of any round of close combat. For the duration of that round, the target may not Attack or Stomp.

magicItems.name: HORN OF THE ASRAI
magicItems.description: The Horn of the Asrai can be used at the beginning of any enemy Movement phase. When used, all enemies able to declare a charge against the bearer of this item must take a Psychology test. If they fail, they must declare a charge against the bearer this turn.

magicItems.name: WAYSTALKER'S CLOAK
magicItems.description: The Waystalker's Cloak gives the wearer the Forest Stalker and Scouts special rules.

magicItems.name: WRAITHSTONE
magicItems.description: All enemy units within 6" of the bearer of the Wraithstone suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: ELYNETT'S BROOCH
magicItems.description: Elynett's Brooch allows the wearer and any unit they are with to re-roll failed Psychology tests.

magicItems.name: WAILING ARROWS
magicItems.description: Enchanted Arrows. Any unit that suffers an unsaved wound from these arrows must make a Panic test.

magicItems.name: ARROWS OF POTENCY
magicItems.description: Enchanted Arrows. Any shots made with the Arrows of Potency have the Multiple Wounds (2) special rule.

magicItems.name: BLIGHT-TIPPED ARROWS
magicItems.description: Enchanted Arrows. Any Character, Monstrous Creature or Monster that suffers an unsaved Wound by Blight- Tipped Arrows must pass a Toughness test at the start of each turn for the remainder of the game or suffer an additional Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: CROWN OF ANTLERS
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains the Impact Hits (D3) special rule. The Impact Hits are Armour Piercing (1).

magicItems.name: ORION'S FAVOUR
magicItems.description: The bearer can re-roll any failed rolls To Hit and/or To Wound made during either the Shooting or Close Combat phase.

magicItems.name: GWYTHERC'S HORN
magicItems.description: All friendly units within 12" of the bearer of Gwytherc's Horn gain +1 to their Leadership when attempting to Rally.

magicItems.name: DRAGONTOOTH ARROWS
magicItems.description: Enchanted Arrows. Any Character, Monstrous Creature or Monster that suffers an unsaved Wound by Dragontooth Arrows gains the Stupidity special rule for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: BATTLE STANDARD OF ATHEL LOREN
magicItems.description: Whenever an enemy spell is cast at a friendly unit within 12" of this standard, roll a D6; on a 5+, the spell is automatically dispelled.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE WILDWOOD
magicItems.description: All enemy units with Line of Sight to this banner suffer -1 to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE ETERNAL QUEEN
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard has the Magic Resistance (3) special rule. In addition, it gains +1 combat resolution bonus if it is within 6" of a forest.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE HUNTER KING
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard add +D6" to their charge range.

magicItems.name: GAEMRATH, THE BANNER OF MIDWINTER
magicItems.description: Gaemrath, the Banner of Midwinter may be used at the start of any close combat phase. Until the start of your next Movement phase, the unit carrying the banner may not move and gains the Unbreakable special rule.

magicItems.name: FAOGHIR, THE BANNER OF DWINDLING
magicItems.description: Enemies that attempt to charge or flee from the unit carrying Faoghir, the Banner of Dwindling roll one dice fewer than normal to determine their charge/flee distance.

magicItems.name: SAEMRATH, THE BANNER OF ZENITH
magicItems.description: Enemy units within 12" of the unit carrying Saemrath, the Banner of the Zenith at the start of their Movement phase may not March.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF MORNING'S CHILL
magicItems.description: All missile attacks targeting the unit carrying this standard suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: TAPESTRY OF TALSYN
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Hold Your Ground (6) special rule.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE WILD HUNT
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains +1 Combat Resolution and may re-roll failed pursuit rolls.

magicItems.name: AECH, THE BANNER OF SPRINGTIDE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying Aech, the Banner of Springtide gains the Quick Shot special rule and may fire Multiple Shots with their bows when choosing Stand & Shoot as a charge reaction.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF MIDSUMMER'S EVE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard ignores To Hit penalties for shooting at enemies in cover.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF ATHEL LOREN
loresOfMagic.attribute: Whenever a spell from the Lore of Athel Loren is successfully cast, all enemy units suffer a -3" penalty to their spell and maximum weapon ranges in their next turn when targeting any friendly units within 6" of the Wizard. This is a cumulative effect.

spells.name: TREE SINGING
spells.description: Tree Singing is a special type of spell which targets a single forest within 24" of the caster. The target immediately moves up to D6+1" in a direction of your choice. A forest cannot move to within 1" of other terrain features.

spells.name: FURY OF THE FOREST
spells.description: Fury of the Forest is a direct damage spell with a range of 18". If the target is within 6" of a forest it suffers 2D6 Strength 4 hits. If the target is partially or wholly within a forest it suffers 3D6 Strength 4 hits.

spells.name: DURTHU'S WRATH
spells.description: Durthu's Wrath is a direct damage spell that can be cast in close combat. All models in the front rank of any unit in base contact with the caster must pass an Initiative test or suffer a Strength 4 hit with the Ignores Armour Saves and Multiple Wounds (D3) special rules.

spells.name: THE TWILIGHT HOST
spells.description: The Twilight Host is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains the Fear special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase. In addition, the target will count as having twice the Unit Strength and number of ranks it really has for the purpose of determining Outnumber and Steadfast.

spells.name: THE HIDDEN PATH
spells.description: The Hidden Path is an augment spell with a range of 18". The unit gains the Ethereal special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase. If the unit becomes engaged in close combat, the spell instantly ends.

spells.name: SPITEFUL TORRENT
spells.description: Remains in play. Spiteful Torrent is a magical vortex that uses the small round template. Any model touched by the template at any point during its move suffers a Strength 2 hit with the Armour Piercing (1) special rule.

spells.name: ASPECT OF ATHEL LOREN
spells.description: Aspect of Athel Loren is an augment aura with a range of 12". Until the start of the caster's next Magic phase, all affected units gain the Magical Ward (6+) special rule.

spells.name: MADRIGAL OF GREENING
spells.description: Madrigal of Greening is a summoning spell with a range of 18". This summons a forest of your choosing no more than 12" in diameter.

spells.name: CAGE OF THORNS
spells.description: Remains in play. Cage of Thorns is a hex spell with a range of 24". While the spell is in effect, the target unit halves all their Movement (rounding up). In addition, the target suffer D6 Strength 3 Hits any time it moves.

spells.name: SAPPING BLIGHT
spells.description: Remains in Play. Sapping Blight is a hex spell with a range of 18". While the spell is in effect, the target has -1 Strength and -1 Toughness (to a minimum of 1).

spells.name: THE CALL OF THE HUNT
spells.description: The Call of the Hunt is a conveyance spell with a range of 18". The target immediately moves forward towards the closest enemy unit within line of sight using the Random Movement (2D6) special rule. If no enemy unit is in line of sight, the unit will move directly forwards. In addition, the unit gains +1 Attack (except mounts) until the start of the caster’s next Magic phase.

spells.name: VERDUROUS HARMONY
spells.description: Verdurous Harmony is an augment aura with a range of 12". All targets instantly recover D3 Wounds' worth of models slain earlier in the battle, just like a summoning spell.

spells.name: ARIEL'S BLESSING
spells.description: Ariel's Blessing is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target gains the Regeneration (4+) special rule until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

forest_spites.name: A BLIGHT OF TERRORS
forest_spites.description: A character with a Blight of Terrors gains the Terror special rule.

forest_spites.name: A CLUSTER OF RADIANTS
forest_spites.description: A character with a Cluster of Radiants adds one extra dice to their Dispel pool in their opponent's Magic phase.

forest_spites.name: AN ANNOYANCE OF NETLINGS
forest_spites.description: Any enemy attempting to strike a character with an Annoyance of Netlings in close combat will suffer -1 To Hit.

forest_spites.name: A MUSTER OF MALEVOLENTS
forest_spites.description:
A Muster of Malevolents is a shooting attack that can be used in addition to the models other shooting attacks. This cannot be used in combination with the Sniper special rule. It has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
6/12" | 2 | Magical Attacks, Multiple Shots (D6), Poisoned Attacks, Quick Shot, Rapid Fire

forest_spites.name: HAGBANE SPITE
forest_spites.description: A Hagbane Spite can be used after an enemy Wizard has successfully cast a spell within 24" instead of dispelling it. When used, the enemy Wizard automatically suffers D3 Hits that Wound on a 4+ with the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

forest_spites.name: A PAGEANT OF SHRIKES
forest_spites.description:
A Pageant of Shrikes is a shooting attack that can be used in addition to the model's other shooting attacks. It has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
12/18" | 4 | Cumbersome, Magical Attacks, Sniper

forest_spites.name: A BEFUDDLEMENT OF MISCHIEFS
forest_spites.description: A Befuddlement of Mischiefs is a hex spell with a range of 18". The target becomes subject to Stupidity until the start of your next Magic phase.

forest_spites.name: A LAMENTATION OF DESPAIRS
forest_spites.description: Lamentation of Despairs is a direct damage spell with a range of 12" which can be used to target enemy Characters or Monsters, even within a unit. The targeted model must pass a Leadership test, or else suffer D3 Wounds which Ignores Armour saves.

forest_spites.name: A MURDER OF SPITES
forest_spites.description:
A Murder of Spites is a close combat attack that can be used in addition to the model's other attacks. It has the following profile:
RANGE | STRENGTH | SPECIAL RULES
Combat | 2 | Magical Attacks, Poisoned Attacks, Random Attacks (D6)

forest_spites.name: A RESPLENDENCE OF LUMINESCENTS
forest_spites.description: A Resplendence of Luminescents gives the character and any unit they join Magical Attacks.
